messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "take on 3 to 5 days each week"
set: ["take on 3 to 5 days each week", "5 mg every 2 to 3 days", "600 mg orally once each morning on days 1 to 3", "3 to 7 days", "Week 5 to week 8: 0.5mg once a week", "about 5 to 6 days", "use an injection on the same day each week", "immediate-release (IR), ages 3 to 5 years", "do not inject two doses within 3 days of each other", "take same way each day", "edema may be most efficiently and safely mobilized by giving this drug on 2 to 4 consecutive days each week", "symptoms can take several days to develop", "Week 1 to week 4: 0.25mg once a week", "Week 9 to week 12: 1mg once a week", "Week 13 to week 16: 1.7mg once a week", "5 mg 3 times a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
